detail_text: This water-repellant, multi-pocket stroller organizer is a must-have companion for any parent. It keeps your baby essentials always within arm's reach, and conveniently turns into a sleep tote bag when you need to use your items away from the stroller. Compatibility: all Bugaboo strollers except the Bugaboo Ant. features & benefits Large enough to fit all your essentials 3 easy-access pockets on the outside to quickly grab a snack or pacifier 2 zippered pockets on the outside to safely store your phone or keys Easy to attach and remove thanks to the sturdy Velcro® tabs so you are ready to stroll in seconds and converts to a hand tote bag—just grab & go Water-repellent materials whats in the box 2x NUK Silicone Soother multiple compartments large main compartment on the inside and easy access pockets on the outside hand tote bag easy to attach and remove converts to a tote bag, just grab & go compatability Bugaboo Bee (2007 model) Bugaboo Bee (2010 model) Bugaboo Bee 3 Bugaboo Bee 5 Bugaboo Bee 6 Bugaboo Buffalo Bugaboo Cameleon (2007 model) Bugaboo Cameleon 3 Bugaboo Cameleon 3 plus Bugaboo Donkey Bugaboo Lynx Bugaboo Donkey 2 Bugaboo Donkey 3 Bugaboo Fox Bugaboo Fox 3 Bugaboo Fox 2 Bugaboo Frog Bugaboo Gecko Bugaboo Runner FAQ's Whats new? The new Bugaboo organizer contains 2 easy pockets on the outside, which allow for easy storage of small items. It also contains a new zippered pocket in the front to hold a phone or keys. It's available in 3 beautiful colors and its modern design perfectly blends with our newest models as well. Which strollers are compatible with the Bugaboo organizer? The Bugaboo organizer is compatible with all our strollers except for the Bugaboo Ant. What are the dimensions and weight of the Bugaboo organizer? The Bugaboo organizer is 35 x 15 x 20 cm / 13.78 x 5.91 x 7.87 in. It weighs 0.38 kg / 0.84 lbs What's the maximum weight capacity of the Bugaboo organizer? The Bugaboo organizer can hold up to 1 kg / 2.2 lbs
detail_html:
This water-repellant, multi-pocket stroller organizer is a must-have companion for any parent. It keeps your baby essentials always within arm's reach, and conveniently turns into a sleep tote bag when you need to use your items away from the stroller. Compatibility: all Bugaboo strollers except the Bugaboo Ant.

features & benefits

  • Large enough to fit all your essentials
  • 3 easy-access pockets on the outside to quickly grab a snack or pacifier
  • 2 zippered pockets on the outside to safely store your phone or keys
  • Easy to attach and remove thanks to the sturdy Velcro® tabs so you are ready to stroll in seconds and converts to a hand tote bag—just grab & go
  • Water-repellent materials

whats in the box

  • 2x NUK Silicone Soother

multiple compartments

large main compartment on the inside and easy access pockets on the outside

hand tote bag

easy to attach and remove

converts to a tote bag, just grab & go

  • Bugaboo Bee (2010 model)

FAQ's

Whats new?

  • The new Bugaboo organizer contains 2 easy pockets on the outside, which allow for easy storage of small items. It also contains a new zippered pocket in the front to hold a phone or keys. It's available in 3 beautiful colors and its modern design perfectly blends with our newest models as well.

Which strollers are compatible with the Bugaboo organizer?

  • The Bugaboo organizer is compatible with all our strollers except for the Bugaboo Ant.

What are the dimensions and weight of the Bugaboo organizer?

  • The Bugaboo organizer is 35 x 15 x 20 cm / 13.78 x 5.91 x 7.87 in. It weighs 0.38 kg / 0.84 lbs

What's the maximum weight capacity of the Bugaboo organizer?

  • The Bugaboo organizer can hold up to 1 kg / 2.2 lbs

detail_html:
Universal Stroller Glider Board - The Smart Solution for Parents with Two Kids

【PRODUCT HIGHLIGHTS】

Dual Wheel Design - Compatible with 99.9% of strollers on the market

40kg Weight Capacity - Sturdy enough for kids aged 2-6 years

3-in-1 Convertible - Switch between standing, sitting and folded modes instantly

️ Safety First - Non-slip pedals, damping wheels and soft cushion for maximum comfort

【WHY CHOOSE OUR STROLLER BOARD?】

Universal Compatibility

Fits most major stroller brands thanks to adjustable connector rods (13" max width) and rotary angle adjustment

All-Terrain Performance

Dual wheel system with shock absorption for smooth rides on pavement, grass or uneven surfaces

Parent-Friendly Features

Quick-release mechanism for easy storage

Nylon lanyard for hanging on stroller handle

Lightweight (1.7kg) yet durable ABS construction

Child Comfort Innovations

Removable padded seat

3-level height adjustment (26-55cm)

Non-slip standing platform

【TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS】

Feature Specification

Material Eco-friendly ABS

Dimensions 33×36×26cm (55cm extended)

Weight Capacity 40kg (88lbs)

Product Weight 1.7kg (3.7lbs)

Wheel Type Dual shock-absorbing

Adjustability 3 height & 3 length positions

Recommended Age 2-6 years

【PACKAGE INCLUDES】

1× Universal Stroller Board

1× Removable Seat Cushion

1× Adjustable Holding Rod

1× Nylon Storage Lanyard

1× Instruction Manual

【IDEAL FOR】

️ Grocery shopping trips

️ Family vacations

️ Park outings

Mall visits

‍‍‍ Any situation where you need to transport two children

product.desc:
Universal Stroller Glider Board - The Smart Solution for Parents with Two Kids

【PRODUCT HIGHLIGHTS】

Dual Wheel Design - Compatible with 99.9% of strollers on the market

40kg Weight Capacity - Sturdy enough for kids aged 2-6 years

3-in-1 Convertible - Switch between standing, sitting and folded modes instantly

️ Safety First - Non-slip pedals, damping wheels and soft cushion for maximum comfort

【WHY CHOOSE OUR STROLLER BOARD?】

Universal Compatibility

Fits most major stroller brands thanks to adjustable connector rods (13" max width) and rotary angle adjustment

All-Terrain Performance

Dual wheel system with shock absorption for smooth rides on pavement, grass or uneven surfaces

Parent-Friendly Features

Quick-release mechanism for easy storage

Nylon lanyard for hanging on stroller handle

Lightweight (1.7kg) yet durable ABS construction

Child Comfort Innovations

Removable padded seat

3-level height adjustment (26-55cm)

Non-slip standing platform

【TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS】

Feature Specification

Material Eco-friendly ABS

Dimensions 33×36×26cm (55cm extended)

Weight Capacity 40kg (88lbs)

Product Weight 1.7kg (3.7lbs)

Wheel Type Dual shock-absorbing

Adjustability 3 height & 3 length positions

Recommended Age 2-6 years

【PACKAGE INCLUDES】

1× Universal Stroller Board

1× Removable Seat Cushion

1× Adjustable Holding Rod

1× Nylon Storage Lanyard

1× Instruction Manual

【IDEAL FOR】

️ Grocery shopping trips

️ Family vacations

️ Park outings

Mall visits

‍‍‍ Any situation where you need to transport two children

Safety Note: Not recommended for lightweight/small strollers. Always secure magic tape properly before use.

Ergonomic contours protect tiny feet, while high-elastic PU wheels absorb shocks and reduce vibration for a comfortable glide. The subtle bear motif adds child-friendly charm without compromising safety.

【Anti-Fall Design】

A diamond pedal pattern increases grip, cutting the chance of slipping when standing. The broad, textured platform keeps feet steady during movement. Low profile design and shock-absorbing wheels improve stability when mounting or on uneven ground.

【2-in-1 Design: Stand & Sit】

The removable seat lets children sit or stand as they choose. When folded, the board can hang from the stroller handle with the included strap—compact, space-saving and travel friendly.

【Adjustable Height】

A rotary knob quickly adjusts pedal height to match different stroller frames. Two connecting rods can be swapped or adjusted to fit varying stroller widths for a level, wobble-free connection.

️【Easy to Install】

No tools required—attach reinforced Velcro straps around the stroller frame, tighten the knobs and set the connectors for a snug fit. Install in minutes, perfect for busy parents.

- Load Capacity: 30 / 35 / 40 KG

- Product Weight: Approx. 1.7 KG

- Dimensions: 33 cm (W) x 36 cm (Seat H) x 26 cm (L without rod) / 55 cm (L with rod)

- Material: Eco-friendly ABS; PU wheels

【Package Included】

- 1 x Portable Baby Stroller Buggy Step Board

Choose double-wheel for wider compatibility and smoother rides, or single-wheel for strollers with a rear bar. This board balances safety, comfort and portability to make every stroll easier and more fun.

Perfect on-the-go accessory with a wide range of applications. Add comfort in seconds!

detail_html:
【3-Mode Universal Stroller Board: 2-in-1 Sit & Stand for 2-6 Years】

The item is ready and will be shipped directly from local warehouses. Same-day delivery on working days, with arrival 2 to 4 days after ordering.

This 2-in-1 stroller board is a parent-friendly solution for two children—featuring 3 switchable modes, universal compatibility , and adjustable design. It’s stable, portable, and suitable for kids 2-6 years (up to 40kg), making errands, walks, and trips easier for families.

【Dual-Wheel Universal Compatibility & Stable Design】

Two Wheel Options for Versatility: Double wheels fit 99.9% of strollers on the market; single wheel works with strollers having a horizontal rear wheel bar. Choose the right type for your stroller.

Secure & Quick Installation: Magic tape binding and rotary buttons fix the board firmly to strollers in seconds. Adjust the pedal’s horizontal angle to match different stroller heights for a snug fit.

Stable & Safe Build: Made of environmentally friendly ABS material (1.7kg product weight) with a load-bearing capacity of 40kg. Damping wheels reduce vibration, while the low center of gravity prevents stroller tilting .

【3 Modes & 2-in-1 Sit-Stand Function】

3 Freely Switchable Modes: Standing mode (for active kids), sitting mode (with soft comfortable cushion for rest), and folding mode (for storage/transport). Adapts to kids’ moods and needs.

Adjustable Space & Comfort: Adjust connector rods to change the walking space (max 13 inches) based on stroller width. Kids have enough room to stand or sit without feeling cramped.

User-Centric Details: Non-slip step board prevents falls, removable seat support rod adds flexibility, and the adjustable holding rod (3-level length + 3-level height) fits kids of different sizes.

【Portable & Easy to Use】

Compact Folding & Storage: Dismantle or hang the board on the stroller handlebar with a nylon lanyard when not in use. Folding mode saves space for car trunks or home storage.

Tool-Free Adjustments: Width, length, and height are easily adjustable without extra tools. 3-level length and height settings enhance compatibility and convenience for parents.

Travel-Friendly: Lightweight 1.7kg design and portable structure make it ideal for mall trips, park walks, or supermarket errands. Take two children out without extra strain.

【Kid-Friendly & Parent-Approved Features】

Suitable for 2-6 Years: Designed for older siblings (2-6 years), giving them their own seat/standing space. Lets parents take care of two children effortlessly.

Comfort & Safety: Soft durable cushion for sitting mode, non-slip pedal, and stable damping wheels—prioritizing kids’ comfort and safety during use.

All-in-One Design: Combines standing, sitting, and folding functions in one board. No need for separate strollers or carriers, saving money and space for families.

【Product Specifications & Package】

Load-Bearing: 40kg

Product Weight: ~1.7kg

Package Includes: 1× Portable Baby Stroller Buggy Step Board

This 2-in-1 stroller board is a parent-friendly solution for two children—featuring 3 switchable modes, universal compatibility , and adjustable design. It’s stable, portable, and suitable for kids 2-6 years (up to 40kg), making errands, walks, and trips easier for families.

【Dual-Wheel Universal Compatibility & Stable Design】

Two Wheel Options for Versatility: Double wheels fit 99.9% of strollers on the market; single wheel works with strollers having a horizontal rear wheel bar. Choose the right type for your stroller.

Secure & Quick Installation: Magic tape binding and rotary buttons fix the board firmly to strollers in seconds. Adjust the pedal’s horizontal angle to match different stroller heights for a snug fit.

Stable & Safe Build: Made of environmentally friendly ABS material (1.7kg product weight) with a load-bearing capacity of 40kg. Damping wheels reduce vibration, while the low center of gravity prevents stroller tilting .

【3 Modes & 2-in-1 Sit-Stand Function】

3 Freely Switchable Modes: Standing mode (for active kids), sitting mode (with soft comfortable cushion for rest), and folding mode (for storage/transport). Adapts to kids’ moods and needs.

Adjustable Space & Comfort: Adjust connector rods to change the walking space (max 13 inches) based on stroller width. Kids have enough room to stand or sit without feeling cramped.

User-Centric Details: Non-slip step board prevents falls, removable seat support rod adds flexibility, and the adjustable holding rod (3-level length + 3-level height) fits kids of different sizes.

【Portable & Easy to Use】

Compact Folding & Storage: Dismantle or hang the board on the stroller handlebar with a nylon lanyard when not in use. Folding mode saves space for car trunks or home storage.

Tool-Free Adjustments: Width, length, and height are easily adjustable without extra tools. 3-level length and height settings enhance compatibility and convenience for parents.

Travel-Friendly: Lightweight 1.7kg design and portable structure make it ideal for mall trips, park walks, or supermarket errands. Take two children out without extra strain.

【Kid-Friendly & Parent-Approved Features】

Suitable for 2-6 Years: Designed for older siblings (2-6 years), giving them their own seat/standing space. Lets parents take care of two children effortlessly.

Comfort & Safety: Soft durable cushion for sitting mode, non-slip pedal, and stable damping wheels—prioritizing kids’ comfort and safety during use.

All-in-One Design: Combines standing, sitting, and folding functions in one board. No need for separate strollers or carriers, saving money and space for families.
